text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not really something I wanna blab to
everyone
about... Hm, then again, you
should probably
know what's up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thing is, I just can't shed this weight.
Like, I've
gotta do something about it,
but I dunno what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't happen to know any tips
and tricks
on how to get back to peak
racing weight, would
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What I like, huh? Sounds good and all,
but what
should I pick?
choice_data_list: 好きなことを運動に活かす、とか？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I can't believe I didn't think
of it right
away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She leads me off, and before we know it,
we're at
the golf course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... Nothing quite clears up the head
like some
good ol' golfing! This is really
good exercise too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the math's a cinch! Each ball I hit
burns one
kilocalorie! Count 'em all up,
and I can calculate a
good calorie
deficit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is keep sending golf balls
flying! I'm
gonna aim for quadruple
digits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You should send all your worries away
with a few
good swings, too! I'll even
coach you up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I accept her invitation, and the two of us
hit
untold numbers of golf balls. Mejiro
Palmer
successfully gets back to her
ideal race weight
too.
